dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: Huh, that reminds me, I did hear someone yelling from down below...

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: But the winds were too strong. Couldn't hear too well.

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: If you have a look, I'm sure you'll see as well that everything looks normal. If something comes up, I'll ring.
